ruleDefinitions.name: GAC DLL Loaded Via Office Applications
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects any GAC DLL being loaded by an Office Product Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mspub\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\onenote\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\onenoteim\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\outlook\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powerpnt\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$")) AND ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\assembly\\\\GAC\\_MSIL"))
